name: ASE Technology

source.quote: For the full year of 2025, the Company reported unaudited net revenues of NT$645,388 million and net income attributable to shareholders of the parent of NT$40,658 million.

description: World's largest chip packaging and testing company (includes SPIL), also an electronics manufacturing services provider.
explain: ASE packages and tests chips, including advanced packaging needed for AI processors. Revenue is unaudited NT$645.4 billion for 2025, converted by AI Atlas at about NT$31.4 per US dollar (approximate 2025 average).
